description: Every skirmish AI against every other on two maps with sides swapped: the standings say who is best and the matrix says by how much against whom. The kit claims greedy beats random on the open field (skirmish_greedy_beats_random owns that number); the tournament asks whether that survives a chokepoint and a side swap. Read the cell table for the per-map answer: the chokepoint is where greedy is weakest. The swap assertion pins that the reversed cell really reverses who plays whom.
